name: data.export
title: Export data
summary: Data of the current state as JSON for external evaluation, or, from the command line and the API, as JSON Lines with one element per line: every element unless a selection is given, so an evaluation selects by filter, package, baseline or variant instead of exporting everything; no paging. With `data store` the only commands so far that take `selection.baseline`: the elements the baseline lists, as they are now. `data store` writes a whole state to a file.
